ui.tutorial.home: This is your lab, at home in {region}. Every lit dot is someone using your model.
ui.tutorial.home.openMap: Let's start on the map. Tap Map.
ui.tutorial.buyModel.openTrees: Time to ship something. Open Trees.
ui.tutorial.buyModel.pickTree: Your model lives in the {capabilityTree} tree. Open it.
ui.tutorial.buyModel.buy: This is your first model. Tap it.
ui.tutorial.buyModel.confirm: Buy it. It costs {hype}, which you have.
ui.tutorial.buyModel.wait: Not quite enough {hype} yet. The clock is running until there is.
ui.tutorial.buildDc.openMap: A model needs somewhere to run. Back to the map.
ui.tutorial.buildDc.tapHomeOrList: Tap your home region, {region}, or use the Regions button.
ui.tutorial.buildDc.build: Build a {dataCentre} here. This is what {cash} is for.
ui.tutorial.buildDc.wait: You need a little more {cash}. The clock is running until you have it.
ui.tutorial.compute: {compute} caps how smart your model can get. Upgrade the model and add sites together, or one waits for the other.
ui.tutorial.meters: {regulation}, {backlash} and {rival} fill up on their own. If any reaches 100%, the run is over.
ui.tutorial.speed: Pause or speed up time here. Headlines crawl along the bottom; tap them for the full news.
ui.tutorial.event: The world wants an answer. Every choice trades one thing for another, and the arrows hint at what.
ui.tutorial.outro: That's the job. You're on your own now.
ui.tutorial.replay: Play the tutorial in my next run
ui.tutorial.replayQueued: The tutorial will run when you found the lab.
